history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration continue its work on centrally monitoring cost recovery in particular to ensure the correct differentiation between spendable and non-spendable income.
history.administration_response: The Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget will conduct another review of mission fund balances from prior periods to ensure the proper classification of spendable and non-spendable revenue. Any amounts found to be improperly categorized as “spendable” will be returned to Member States. The Office conducted another review of the fund balances of peacekeeping missions and reclassified revenue that it found to have been incorrectly posted as spendable revenue. This revenue will be returned to Member States. The Office is also conducting training and outreach to mission staff to enable them to make the appropriate classification of revenue in the future.
history.board_assessment: The Administration improved staff training and post-closing testing during fiscal year 2023/24. The monitoring remains in progress. The Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: The Administration provided guidance to missions on the classification of spendable and non-spendable revenue. Information on classification of revenue is provided in closing instructions, training courses and policy guidance. The missions’ finance staff are instructed to review the classifications prior to the closure of accounts at the end of the financial year and to make any required corrections. The Administration will continue its central review of the cost recovery funds as part of its normal scope of work and the information will be made available on the dashboard. The Administration considers this recommendation to have been implemented and requests its closure by the Board.

history.administration_response: The recommendation has been implemented. This information is communicated through closing instructions, training courses and policy guidance. Missions’ finance staff are instructed to review revenue classifications prior to the year- end account closure and to make any necessary adjustments.
history.board_assessment: The Board notes the implementation of a new dashboard to facilitate the classification between spendable and non-spendable revenue. Corrections and controls are now performed on a regular basis. The recommendation is considered implemented.
